fields.climate: tropical oceanic; moderated by trade winds; a dry season from April to November and a more humid season from December to March
fields.terrain: low coral atolls in north; volcanic, hilly islands in south
fields.farm: coconuts, vegetables, papayas, pork, sweet potatoes, tomatoes, fruits, mangoes/guavas, watermelons, chicken
fields.industries: fishing, fruit processing, tourism, clothing, handicrafts
